jobs.description:
About The Company

Vantor is forging the new frontier of spatial intelligence, helping decision makers and operators navigate what's happening now and shape what's coming next. Vantor is a place for problem solvers, changemakers, and go-getters—where people are working together to help our customers see the world differently, and in doing so, be seen differently. Come be part of a mission, not just a job, where you can: shape your own future, build the next big thing, and change the world.

About The Role

Vantor is currently seeking a Big Data Analyst to join our dynamic team. This position will be based at our facility in Herndon, Virginia, with additional work at the customer site in Springfield, VA. As a vital member of our team, you will play a crucial role in supporting our mission partners by analyzing vast datasets, developing data-driven insights, and contributing to the enhancement of our analytical capabilities. You will work closely with software developers, ETL engineers, and cybersecurity teams to create and maintain complex applications leveraging open-source tools. Your expertise will directly impact mission success by informing decision-making processes and refining data strategies.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate must possess an active TS/SCI clearance and be willing to obtain a CI polygraph. A bachelor’s degree in a relevant field is required; however, equivalent experience may be considered in lieu of a degree. Candidates should have at least five years of experience as a data analyst, data scientist, or similar role, with proven ability to formulate repeatable data evaluation processes and communicate findings effectively to government officials. In-depth knowledge of technical data types such as telemetry, telecommunication protocols—including cellular and Wi-Fi—is essential. Proficiency in scripting languages like Python, SQL, Spark, or PySpark is required. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong time-management abilities, and experience working in fast-paced environments are critical. The candidate must be able to work on-site in Herndon, VA, with flexibility to work in Springfield, VA, as needed.

Responsibilities

Your primary responsibilities will include performing and developing dataset evaluations to inform government decision-making processes. You will shape data engineering approaches to enhance analytic tradecraft within our applications and identify gaps within our data corpus and analytical capabilities. Collaborating closely with software developers, you will provide feedback during requirements gathering and application development. Additionally, you will work directly with end-users to offer subject matter expertise on data and application-related inquiries. Your role will also involve documenting analytical methodologies, ensuring they remain current, and translating technical conclusions into understandable presentations for broader audiences. You will contribute to the continuous improvement of our data evaluation processes and support the integration of new analytical tools and techniques.

Benefits

Vantor offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support your professional and personal growth. Our benefits include a competitive 401(k) plan with company matching contributions, mental health resources, and unique perks such as student loan repayment assistance, adoption reimbursement, and pet insurance. We prioritize work-life balance and provide a supportive environment for our employees to thrive. Additional benefits and details can be found on our company website. We are committed to fostering a workplace where all employees feel valued, respected, and empowered to contribute their best.

Equal Opportunity

Vantor is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive workplace. We believe in fostering an environment where all team members feel respected, valued, and encouraged to share their ideas. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We are dedicated to maintaining a diverse and equitable workplace that reflects our values and supports innovation and collaboration.

Company Description

You may know us as FIJI Water, POM Wonderful, JUSTIN Vineyards & Winery, Teleflora, and Wonderful Halos, but we’re all Wonderful. We have an exciting opportunity for a Senior Healthcare Data Analyst, Health Plan Strategy
to help shape the strategy and performance of The Wonderful Company’s U.S. self-funded health plans.

This is a hands-on healthcare analytics role for someone who can turn complex medical, pharmacy, clinical, financial, and eligibility data into meaningful insights and recommendations. You’ll analyze what’s driving healthcare costs and utilization, forecast future trends, evaluate programs and vendor performance, and identify opportunities to improve employee health outcomes while managing total healthcare spend.

Working closely with Benefits leadership and our Wonderful Wellness Centers, you’ll help connect data to decisions across health plan design, clinical programs, vendor strategy, and long-term healthcare planning. This is a senior individual-contributor role with significant visibility and the opportunity to influence strategy through analytics, project leadership, and cross-functional partnership.

The position reports to the Sr. Director, Health Plan & Benefits and works closely with the Director, Global Benefits.

This position is based at our West Los Angeles, CA office. We work a hybrid schedule with an in-office requirement Monday through Wednesday and the option to work remotely Thursday and Friday.

Job Description

Analyze medical, pharmacy, clinical, financial, and eligibility data using SQL and other analytical tools to identify cost drivers, utilization patterns, and emerging trends.
Develop forecasting models, cost projections, trend analyses, and scenarios to support budgeting and long-term health plan strategy.
Translate complex healthcare data into actionable recommendations related to plan design, cost management, clinical programs, and employee health outcomes.
Establish financial, clinical, and utilization metrics and reporting frameworks to monitor health plan performance.
Evaluate health plan, vendor, and clinical program performance, including financial impact, health outcomes, utilization, member experience, and ROI.
Conduct benchmarking analyses to identify opportunities to improve plan performance and benefit design.
Identify opportunities to leverage The Wonderful Company’s on-site health centers and clinical resources to improve health outcomes and reduce avoidable healthcare costs.
Partner with Benefits leadership and the Chief Medical Officer to evaluate significant clinical, utilization, and cost trends.
Develop clear, executive-ready presentations that turn complex analysis into key insights and recommendations.
Lead cross-functional analytical projects by aligning stakeholders, managing timelines, and driving work through completion.

Qualifications

4+ years of healthcare data analytics experience working with medical and/or pharmacy claims data.
Hands-on experience analyzing large healthcare datasets and identifying cost, utilization, and performance trends.
Proficiency with SQL and experience with reporting or visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or SSRS.
Experience with financial modeling, forecasting, trend analysis, or healthcare cost analysis.
Strong understanding of healthcare cost and utilization drivers with the ability to translate analysis into business recommendations.
Experience communicating complex findings to non-technical stakeholders and senior leaders.
Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience analyzing healthcare claims or plan performance for self-funded employer populations.
Experience within a self-funded employer, health plan/payer, TPA, PBM, benefits consulting firm, or healthcare analytics organization.
Knowledge of employer-sponsored health benefits, health plan design, healthcare benchmarking, and/or clinical program evaluation.
Master’s degree in a related field.

jobs.title: Customer Success Engineer
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too.

We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s machine learning open source and hosted tools. That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety, digitizing floor plans, preserving coral reef populations, guiding drone flight, and much more.

Roboflow is supported by great customers and investors, having raised over 63 million from Y Combinator, Google Ventures, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors.

Roboflowers are passionate builders who value ownership, accountability, and a bias toward action. We're curious, hands-on with new tech, and prefer showing our work over talking about it. Many of us have a founder mindset and thrive in our high-autonomy environment.

Who You Are

You are technically curious, customer-focused, and get satisfaction from helping people become capable and confident users of complex technology. You may come from Customer Success, technical enablement, Developer Relations, Support, Solutions Engineering, or another customer-facing technical role.

You enjoy understanding why customers struggle with a product and turning those insights into better ways of teaching thousands of customers — not simply solving the same problem repeatedly.

You are comfortable teaching technical concepts live, creating clear educational content, and guiding customers through unfamiliar workflows. You know when to demonstrate, when to advise, and importantly when to let the customer drive the keyboard.

You look for patterns. If several customers ask the same question, your instinct is not simply to answer it again; it is to create the guide, video, workshop, workflow, or program that means the next customer can answer it themselves.

Empathetic to customer needs and the importance of communicating in remote relationships, you can provide clear and prescriptive guidance while maintaining the boundaries required for a scalable self-service customer experience.

Many Roboflowers have used our tools before joining. One of the best ways to stand out amongst other applicants is to write about something you have built with Roboflow or contribute to one of our open source projects.

We are hiring Customer Success Engineers to help our self-serve and Corporate customers become successful, independent users of Roboflow. You will have direct input on the evolution of this role, the Customer Success Engineering function, and how Roboflow enables an increasingly large community of computer vision practitioners.

If you enjoy teaching technical concepts, building programs and content, and finding scalable ways to help customers succeed, let’s have a chat.

What You’ll Do

Roboflow's product-led growth customers are building an enormous variety of computer vision applications. Customer Success powers up those customers with the technical knowledge, best practices, and structured enablement they need to expand how they use Roboflow and confidently progress from experimentation into production.

The Function Operates Through Two Complementary Enablement Models

Scalable enablement — recurring webinars, onboarding sessions, technical workshops, clinics, office hours, learning journeys, and reusable educational content designed to help large numbers of self-serve customers progress independently.
Targeted 1:1 enablement — structured, time-bound delivery of the Targeted Enablement Option Pack for qualifying Corporate customers who need additional guidance through core Roboflow functionality.

The objective isn't to do the customer's work for them; it is to remove educational friction and give customers the knowledge, tools, and confidence to progress independently.

You will teach customers how to work effectively with datasets, annotations, model training and evaluation, and the wider Roboflow platform. Just as importantly, you will identify recurring points of friction and turn them into programs and reusable assets that can benefit hundreds or thousands of future customers.

Role And Responsibilities

Develop, deliver, and continually improve technical enablement programs for Roboflow's self-serve customer base, covering platform onboarding, annotation strategy and quality, dataset management, model training and evaluation, workflows and deployments and workspace administration
Host bi-weekly webinars, technical workshops, office hours, and other live educational sessions
Develop learning journeys that guide customers towards increasingly sophisticated use of Roboflow technology
Deliver Roboflow's structured 1:1 Targeted Enablement Option Pack for qualifying customers
Create reusable technical enablement assets including documentation, videos, walkthroughs, recordings, and reference materials
Identify recurring customer questions and turn them into scalable educational programs or assets
Monitor customer activation and engagement signals to identify users and cohorts who may benefit from specific enablement programs
Measure participation and effectiveness of enablement programs for continual improvement
Collaborate with Product to identify and close recurring knowledge and usability gaps
Stay current with the latest Roboflow product features, releases, workflows, and recommended best practices

Technical Proficiency

Working knowledge of computer vision and machine learning, including datasets, annotation, model training, evaluation, and inference
Comfortable using Python and working with APIs, notebooks, and common developer tooling
Ability to become highly proficient across the Roboflow platform and demonstrate its workflows confidently to customers
Understanding of model evaluation concepts including precision, recall, confidence thresholds, confusion matrices, and common causes of poor model performance
Understanding of dataset quality, annotation strategy, dataset versioning, and approaches for identifying difficult or underrepresented examples
Ability to translate technical concepts into clear, practical guidance for users with varying levels of ML experience

Individual Skills

Technical Teaching: Able to explain unfamiliar technical concepts clearly and adapt the explanation to the customer's level of experience
Pattern Recognition: Recognize recurring questions and friction across customer interactions and identify opportunities to solve them systematically
Program Delivery: Methodical planning and delivery of structured 1:1 sessions, webinars, workshops, and other customer-facing technical programs
Content Creation: Able to create concise, technically accurate educational material across written, recorded, and live formats
Workload Management: Manage multiple customers progressing through structured enablement while balancing program delivery and reusable content creation
Customer Communication: Communicate clearly and professionally before, during, and after enablement engagements, setting expectations around preparation, outcomes, and next steps

Bonus Skills

Experience using the Roboflow platform or contributing to the Roboflow ecosystem
Previous experience in Customer Success, technical enablement, Developer Relations, technical education, Solutions Engineering, or technical Support
Experience creating technical educational content such as tutorials, videos, workshops, documentation, or developer courses
Experience delivering webinars, workshops, technical demonstrations, or customer training
Experience working with product-led growth or self-service SaaS customers
Experience using product telemetry or customer activation data to inform customer engagement programs

Who You'll Be Working With

Our team of over 100 attracts talent like executives that wanted to return to building, founders with a 100M+ exit, Roboflow users turned team members, open source contributors, a cyclist who biked across the United States, prolific high school hackers, a CTO from 100+ engineering organization, amongst many exceptional others.

As an early Customer Success Engineer hire, you'll work closely with Support & Success leadership and partner with Product, Sales, and Field Engineering. You won't simply inherit an established playbook — you'll help build the programs, content, tooling, and working practices that define Customer Success at Roboflow.

Where You'll Work

Roboflow is distributed across the US and Europe. We currently have Hubs in New York City, San Francisco and São Paulo (with plans to open more as we grow density in new cities). We provide opportunities (like team onsites in different cities) and resources (like a $4000/yr travel stipend) to work in person with other team members as much as you'd like, while also supporting remote team members. You can work from one of our Hubs (we offer a relocation bonus), work from home, work at co-working spaces, etc. We want you to work where you work best!

When You'll Work

Roboflow primarily operates during the daytime hours in the US and there are some synchronous meetings you’ll be expected to attend each week.

What You'll Receive

To determine your salary, we use a number of market and data-driven salary sources. We review all salaries every six months to ensure we stay in line with the market.

📈 In addition to our cash compensation, we offer generous perks and benefits. Below are some of the highlights:

$4000/yr Travel Stipend to travel anywhere anytime to work alongside other Roboflowers
$350/mo Productivity stipend to spend on things that make your work environment more productive, like high-speed internet at home or a co-working space
Cover up to 100% of your health insurance costs for you and your partner or family
Equity in the company so we are all invested in the future of computer vision

📅 Within one week, you will…

Learn about computer vision, our product, company, customers, and vision
Complete the core self-serve Roboflow journey from dataset creation through model training and inference
Begin shadowing customer enablement and Support interactions to understand common customer friction

📅 Within one month, you will…

Onboard in person with your manager (you'll come to our NY or SF Hub!)
Become familiar with the Customer Success Engineer function, Targeted Enablement Option Pack, and its scope boundaries
Shadow and begin participating in Targeted Enablement sessions
Compose your first Targeted Enablement Program
Create or significantly improve your first reusable customer enablement artifact
Participate in 1:many enablement webinars

📅 Within six months, you will…

Independently own and deliver both recurring 1:many enablement programs and 1:1 Targeted Enablement engagements.
Own and improve reusable educational content and enablement programs
Identify recurring customer friction and turn those insights into improvements across Product, Support, and CSE
Demonstrate measurable contribution to customer adoption and scalable reduction of repetitive enablement demand

Not sure if this is you?

We want a diverse, global team with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job sounds great, but you’re not sure if you qualify, look into our Former Founders role. We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time.

Learn More About Us

We are building a diverse Distributed team that is distributed across the globe. Roboflow is an equal opportunity workplace; we welcome people from all backgrounds, communities, and experiences.

Build an Aviation Career You’re Proud Of

Ongoing customer service training.

Ongoing training on various company functions as an Employee-Owner to broaden business acumen.

The EPC Project Coordinator (PC) is responsible for end‑to‑end execution of EPC Projects from purchase order receipt through project closeout and warranty. EPC stands for Engineering Procurement & Construction. This role serves as the primary point of coordination and communication between customers, factories, and internal cross‑functional teams to ensure projects are executed accurately, on schedule, and in compliance with contractual and documentation requirements. Though not a technical expert, a project’s success is directly tied to how effective the PC is with coordinating all functions to complete deliverables; there is no Project Manager overseeing success on the Experitec side of the project. Our project partners will often have a Project Manager the PC will work closely with.

The Project Coordinator owns project execution processes, proactively manages risk (including liquidated damages), maintains financial and system accuracy, and ensures all commercial and technical documentation is delivered on time. This role is execution‑focused, not administrative, and plays a critical part in customer satisfaction, margin protection, and project success.

Opportunities To Make An Impact

Owning the end‑to‑end EPC project execution lifecycle from purchase order receipt through project closeout, ensuring contractual, financial, schedule, and documentation obligations are met.
Interpreting contracts, purchase orders, and the Schedule of Submittals (SOS) to confirm scope, inclusions, exclusions, documentation requirements, and delivery commitments.
Establishing, maintaining, and ensuring accuracy of project data across IFS, SharePoint, DocBoss, and other supporting systems, maintaining audit‑ready and traceable records.
Developing and managing the project execution plan, delivery schedule, and SOS, ensuring alignment across internal teams, suppliers, factories, and customers.
Coordinating and leading internal and customer kickoff meetings, along with ongoing project‑specific meetings, to align responsibilities, execution strategy, and communication cadence.
Collaborating closely with Program Managers, Application Engineers, Drafters, Shop Technicians, Suppliers, Emerson Project Management (external team), and other stakeholders to ensure timely, complete, and accurate deliverables.
Proactively identifying execution, documentation, schedule, and liquidated damages risks; escalating issues with recommended mitigation actions to protect schedule, margin, and customer commitments.
Coordinating procurement and manufacturing activities including order commitments, shop order creation and tracking, supplier communication, expediting, inspections, equipment releases, and delivery milestones.

Experience with using Smartsheet

Detail-oriented, able to develop and maintain highly organized work environment, and able to effectively prioritize

Who We Are

Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too.

We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s machine learning open source and hosted tools. That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety, digitizing floor plans, preserving coral reef populations, guiding drone flight, and much more.

Roboflow is supported by great customers and investors, having raised over 63 million from Y Combinator, Google Ventures, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors.

Roboflowers are passionate builders who value ownership, accountability, and a bias toward action. We're curious, hands-on with new tech, and prefer showing our work over talking about it. Many of us have a founder mindset and thrive in our high-autonomy environment.

Who You Are

You are technically curious, customer-focused, and get satisfaction from helping people become capable and confident users of complex technology. You may come from Customer Success, technical enablement, Developer Relations, Support, Solutions Engineering, or another customer-facing technical role.

You enjoy understanding why customers struggle with a product and turning those insights into better ways of teaching thousands of customers — not simply solving the same problem repeatedly.

You are comfortable teaching technical concepts live, creating clear educational content, and guiding customers through unfamiliar workflows. You know when to demonstrate, when to advise, and importantly when to let the customer drive the keyboard.

You look for patterns. If several customers ask the same question, your instinct is not simply to answer it again; it is to create the guide, video, workshop, workflow, or program that means the next customer can answer it themselves.

Empathetic to customer needs and the importance of communicating in remote relationships, you can provide clear and prescriptive guidance while maintaining the boundaries required for a scalable self-service customer experience.

Many Roboflowers have used our tools before joining. One of the best ways to stand out amongst other applicants is to write about something you have built with Roboflow or contribute to one of our open source projects.

We are hiring Customer Success Engineers to help our self-serve and Corporate customers become successful, independent users of Roboflow. You will have direct input on the evolution of this role, the Customer Success Engineering function, and how Roboflow enables an increasingly large community of computer vision practitioners.

If you enjoy teaching technical concepts, building programs and content, and finding scalable ways to help customers succeed, let’s have a chat.

What You’ll Do

Roboflow's product-led growth customers are building an enormous variety of computer vision applications. Customer Success powers up those customers with the technical knowledge, best practices, and structured enablement they need to expand how they use Roboflow and confidently progress from experimentation into production.

The Function Operates Through Two Complementary Enablement Models

Scalable enablement — recurring webinars, onboarding sessions, technical workshops, clinics, office hours, learning journeys, and reusable educational content designed to help large numbers of self-serve customers progress independently.
Targeted 1:1 enablement — structured, time-bound delivery of the Targeted Enablement Option Pack for qualifying Corporate customers who need additional guidance through core Roboflow functionality.

The objective isn't to do the customer's work for them; it is to remove educational friction and give customers the knowledge, tools, and confidence to progress independently.

You will teach customers how to work effectively with datasets, annotations, model training and evaluation, and the wider Roboflow platform. Just as importantly, you will identify recurring points of friction and turn them into programs and reusable assets that can benefit hundreds or thousands of future customers.

Role And Responsibilities

Develop, deliver, and continually improve technical enablement programs for Roboflow's self-serve customer base, covering platform onboarding, annotation strategy and quality, dataset management, model training and evaluation, workflows and deployments and workspace administration
Host bi-weekly webinars, technical workshops, office hours, and other live educational sessions
Develop learning journeys that guide customers towards increasingly sophisticated use of Roboflow technology
Deliver Roboflow's structured 1:1 Targeted Enablement Option Pack for qualifying customers
Create reusable technical enablement assets including documentation, videos, walkthroughs, recordings, and reference materials
Identify recurring customer questions and turn them into scalable educational programs or assets
Monitor customer activation and engagement signals to identify users and cohorts who may benefit from specific enablement programs
Measure participation and effectiveness of enablement programs for continual improvement
Collaborate with Product to identify and close recurring knowledge and usability gaps
Stay current with the latest Roboflow product features, releases, workflows, and recommended best practices

Technical Proficiency

Working knowledge of computer vision and machine learning, including datasets, annotation, model training, evaluation, and inference
Comfortable using Python and working with APIs, notebooks, and common developer tooling
Ability to become highly proficient across the Roboflow platform and demonstrate its workflows confidently to customers
Understanding of model evaluation concepts including precision, recall, confidence thresholds, confusion matrices, and common causes of poor model performance
Understanding of dataset quality, annotation strategy, dataset versioning, and approaches for identifying difficult or underrepresented examples
Ability to translate technical concepts into clear, practical guidance for users with varying levels of ML experience

Individual Skills

Technical Teaching: Able to explain unfamiliar technical concepts clearly and adapt the explanation to the customer's level of experience
Pattern Recognition: Recognize recurring questions and friction across customer interactions and identify opportunities to solve them systematically
Program Delivery: Methodical planning and delivery of structured 1:1 sessions, webinars, workshops, and other customer-facing technical programs
Content Creation: Able to create concise, technically accurate educational material across written, recorded, and live formats
Workload Management: Manage multiple customers progressing through structured enablement while balancing program delivery and reusable content creation
Customer Communication: Communicate clearly and professionally before, during, and after enablement engagements, setting expectations around preparation, outcomes, and next steps

Bonus Skills

Experience using the Roboflow platform or contributing to the Roboflow ecosystem
Previous experience in Customer Success, technical enablement, Developer Relations, technical education, Solutions Engineering, or technical Support
Experience creating technical educational content such as tutorials, videos, workshops, documentation, or developer courses
Experience delivering webinars, workshops, technical demonstrations, or customer training
Experience working with product-led growth or self-service SaaS customers
Experience using product telemetry or customer activation data to inform customer engagement programs

Who You'll Be Working With

Our team of over 100 attracts talent like executives that wanted to return to building, founders with a 100M+ exit, Roboflow users turned team members, open source contributors, a cyclist who biked across the United States, prolific high school hackers, a CTO from 100+ engineering organization, amongst many exceptional others.

As an early Customer Success Engineer hire, you'll work closely with Support & Success leadership and partner with Product, Sales, and Field Engineering. You won't simply inherit an established playbook — you'll help build the programs, content, tooling, and working practices that define Customer Success at Roboflow.

Where You'll Work

Roboflow is distributed across the US and Europe. We currently have Hubs in New York City, San Francisco and São Paulo (with plans to open more as we grow density in new cities). We provide opportunities (like team onsites in different cities) and resources (like a $4000/yr travel stipend) to work in person with other team members as much as you'd like, while also supporting remote team members. You can work from one of our Hubs (we offer a relocation bonus), work from home, work at co-working spaces, etc. We want you to work where you work best!

When You'll Work

Roboflow primarily operates during the daytime hours in the US and there are some synchronous meetings you’ll be expected to attend each week.

What You'll Receive

To determine your salary, we use a number of market and data-driven salary sources. We review all salaries every six months to ensure we stay in line with the market.

📈 In addition to our cash compensation, we offer generous perks and benefits. Below are some of the highlights:

$4000/yr Travel Stipend to travel anywhere anytime to work alongside other Roboflowers
$350/mo Productivity stipend to spend on things that make your work environment more productive, like high-speed internet at home or a co-working space

Equity in the company so we are all invested in the future of computer vision

📅 Within one week, you will…

Complete the core self-serve Roboflow journey from dataset creation through model training and inference
Begin shadowing customer enablement and Support interactions to understand common customer friction

📅 Within one month, you will…

Participate in 1:many enablement webinars

📅 Within six months, you will…

Independently own and deliver both recurring 1:many enablement programs and 1:1 Targeted Enablement engagements.
Own and improve reusable educational content and enablement programs
Identify recurring customer friction and turn those insights into improvements across Product, Support, and CSE

Not sure if this is you?

San Antonio, TX

Build an Aviation Career You’re Proud Of

As a Sr Pricing Data Analyst

You will also work with Customer Programs, Finance, Supply Chain and any other related parties to generate, submit, and validate required reports and ensure that the required financial steps are followed internally.

What You’ll Do

Own customer dispute resolution as the primary POC, supporting CPMs across both product lines; track, manage, and action disputes while balancing financial integrity and customer experience, including direct customer interaction for escalated issues.

Oversee pricing, estimating, billing, and financial analysis activities, ensuring accurate estimates and invoicing, effective forecasting, and achievement of team metrics and targets.

Audit and manage customer billing, ensuring invoices are accurate, timely, and aligned with contractual terms, project milestones, and approved pricing; support billing reconciliation and resolution of invoicing questions.
Ensure financial and data integrity by maintaining alignment between approved estimates, actual costs, and financial results; support month-end close through estimate reviews, billing reconciliation, revenue analysis, and variance reporting.
Analyze and report trends and patterns in customer disputes, estimating, and invoicing issues, providing feedback to analysts and identifying opportunities to improve processes and reduce errors.
Partner closely with Finance, Customer Program Managers, Operations, Sales, and Product Management, providing pricing insights and serving as the primary support for contract interpretation related to pricing, as well as margin and invoicing research and resolution.
Lead continuous improvement and manage pricing priorities, strengthening pricing, estimating, billing, and financial processes while driving consistency, efficiency, and process improvement across the organization.
Serve as backup to the Manager, Customer Programs for pricing processes, QDP, and financial forecasting, while providing mentorship, reviewing team work quality, supporting professional development, and driving pricing best practices across the team.

Basic Qualifications

Associate degree or higher in Finance, Accounting, Data Analytics, Business Administration, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.
2+ years of experience in financial, accounting, contracting, invoicing, pricing, estimating, or other related transactional or analytical work requiring accuracy and attention to detail.

Experience using and managing existing Power BI dashboards, including applying filters and views, monitoring data, and reviewing and interpreting dashboard information.

Experience with SQL, ERP systems, and CRM platforms.
Experience in the aerospace industry or a similarly regulated manufacturing environment preferred.

The EPC Project Coordinator (PC) is responsible for end‑to‑end execution of EPC Projects from purchase order receipt through project closeout and warranty. EPC stands for Engineering Procurement & Construction. This role serves as the primary point of coordination and communication between customers, factories, and internal cross‑functional teams to ensure projects are executed accurately, on schedule, and in compliance with contractual and documentation requirements. Our project partners will often have a Project Manager the PC will work closely with.

The Project Coordinator owns project execution processes, proactively manages risk (including liquidated damages), maintains financial and system accuracy, and ensures all commercial and technical documentation is delivered on time. Owning the end‑to‑end EPC project execution lifecycle from purchase order receipt through project closeout, ensuring contractual, financial, schedule, and documentation obligations are met.
Interpreting contracts, purchase orders, and the Schedule of Submittals (SOS) to confirm scope, inclusions, exclusions, documentation requirements, and delivery commitments.

Coordinating and leading internal and customer kickoff meetings, along with ongoing project‑specific meetings, to align responsibilities, execution strategy, and communication cadence.
Collaborating closely with Program Managers, Application Engineers, Drafters, Shop Technicians, Suppliers, Emerson Project Management (external team), and other stakeholders to ensure timely, complete, and accurate deliverables.
Proactively identifying execution, documentation, schedule, and liquidated damages risks; escalating issues with recommended mitigation actions to protect schedule, margin, and customer commitments.
Coordinating procurement and manufacturing activities including order commitments, shop order creation and tracking, supplier communication, expediting, inspections, equipment releases, and delivery milestones.
Tracking manufacturing progress, inspections, shipping releases, packing lists, milestone invoicing requirements, and customer delivery updates to ensure delivery schedules are met.
Leading and supporting documentation execution by confirming requirements, managing revisions, tracking submittal approvals and returns, and ensuring all commercial, technical, and quality documentation is accurate, version‑controlled, and submitted on time.
Ensuring documentation reports, expediting needs, and system data remain accurate and up to date throughout the project lifecycle.
Serving as the primary owner of change order management, coordinating revised purchase orders, schedules, documentation, and financial impacts while clearly communicating changes to customers, factories, and internal stakeholders.
Ensuring financial accuracy in IFS, including milestone invoicing coordination, revenue recognition support, and monitoring financial impacts related to schedule, documentation, or scope changes.

Data Analyst I (Remote)

As the leading innovator in Vehicle-to-Government (V2Gov) technology, Vitu is transforming the way vehicles, businesses, government, and drivers interact with one another.

Vitu provides innovative, cutting-edge services to the motor vehicle industry. Our namesake solution manages titling and registration transactions in all 50 states and across multiple locations — all on one platform. With the mission of expanding and automating Vehicle-to-Government (V2Gov) transactions, the Vitu platform is reimagining how drivers, businesses and governments interact with vehicles. Vitu has offices in California, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Minnesota, Montana, North Carolina, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Oregon, Pennsylvania, and Virginia.

Job Summary

The Data Analyst role is to write code, build data pipelines, and apply AI to turn revenue data into actionable insight and automation. This role is crucial in strengthening data integrity, ensuring accurate reporting, and building analytics that help to win new business, expand existing accounts, and improve internal efficiency. Ideal candidate is a strong programmer and analytical thinker who is comfortable working in SQL and Python, putting AI tools to practical use, and explaining results to non-technical audiences. HubSpot CRM experience is preferred, but we value your ability to work with data at scale more than your familiarity with any single platform. You will support decision-making, sales, and customer success.

Key Responsibilities

Data Engineering & Integrity

Build and maintain Python and SQL scripts and pipelines that move and transform data between HubSpot and other systems, keeping it accurate, complete, and consistent.
Design and run data cleansing initiatives that eliminate duplicates, correct misaligned fields, and standardize company and contact records, using repeatable, code-driven methods rather than one-off manual fixes.

Analytics & Reporting

Build, maintain, and automate dashboards in PowerBI tools (such as Data Studio) and HubSpot that visualize key performance metrics.
Translate raw data into clear, executive-ready reports and recommendations that influence business strategy.
Support ad hoc analytics requests from leadership, providing accurate, timely insights across multiple departments.

AI & Automation

Design, build, and deploy AI-assisted workflows (LLM APIs, prompt design, agents) that automate reporting, data enrichment, classification, and summarization.
Evaluate AI tools and models for operational use cases, weighing accuracy, cost, and risk, and recommend where they add real value.
Document and monitor AI-driven processes so results stay reliable and auditable.
Identify and automate manual reporting and repetitive data tasks, in HubSpot and beyond.

Qualifications

Required

4 to 7 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or revenue operations.
Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, including data manipulation , scripting for automation, and working with REST APIs.
Hands-on experience applying AI and LLM tools to real workflows (for example, LLM APIs, prompt engineering, or AI-assisted automation).
Ability to communicate complex data insights clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred

HubSpot CRM experience (properties, workflows, custom reports, data migration).
Experience with Coefficient or similar spreadsheet-to-CRM connectors.
Experience with a cloud data warehouse (such as BigQuery) and version control (Git).

Compensation

The salary range for this position is: $68,000-$72,000 annually

The final pay for this position will be determined by multiple factors including, but not limited to, location, education, experience, training and skills.
